concepts.gloss_en: The future renewal of the world (the eschatological event when the world will be conducted by wonders/Providence, not nature)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same lesson (lm2:8) and identical in meaning: the future renewal of the world (chiddush ha'olam le'atid) — one tied to chesed/the new song building the world, the other to the world being conducted by wonders/Providence. Same word, same concept, straightforward merge.
